sources.name: LiveBench Global Average
sources.notes: Current raw CSV and categories JSON verified on 2026-10-08, including Claude Haiku 5.5 xHigh and Max Effort rows. Benchmark release remains LiveBench-2026-06-25; models are appended afterward. updated = CSV Last-Modified HTTP header (2026-10-07), not benchmark release date. Mean of task scores per category, then mean of all 7 category means for global, matching the site; unrounded arithmetic retained. Every exact-checkpoint explicitly named effort variant remains separate; effort does not imply thinking mode, fallback policy or harness. Existing exact-version variants are retained; DeepSeek original/preview and undated Qwen Max cannot establish roster 0813/0902 checkpoints and remain excluded. Global is reference-only because it overlaps its retained category components.
